audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----
audit_comment: The WSG swimmer's motion-chain fold, the second seam round after gap closure: no new book pages, the R499 pattern applied to the water chapter. One swimmer state flows through five landed headers: the swimming rates (rules/wsgswim.h R450: 40 feet base, the 2/3 subsurface cut, the 2x high speed with the 1/10 endurance cut, the 3-per-turn rest regain, the 1-3/4-6 inch current ranges), the dive leg (rules/wsgdive.h R452: the 2 inch or 20 foot base, doubled moderate and tripled heavy), the surfacing leg (rules/wsgbreath.h R454: the same 2 inch base, the 5 foot inert buoyancy rise), the moving-water hazards (rules/wsgmwater.h R451: the 1-10 stream rating, the two-round hold cadence, the 40/100 foot waterfall thresholds, the half and tenth damage divisors) and the treading economy (rules/wsgtread.h R453: 2 turns per endurance point, 1 round per strength point, the +1 check ladder). The findings: the vertical rates equal each other and are half the horizontal base; the Table 24 dive column matches the dive prose exactly; the encumbrance paradox (the same weight that halves speed doubles the sink rate); the forty-foot agreement between the dive falling-damage threshold and the waterfall save threshold; and the two different cumulative check ladders (+2 breath, +1 treading).
audit_label: R500 WSG swimmer motion fold audit

banner.provenance: No new book pages: every value is the landed original re-read from its header (wsmHumanSwimRateFt, wsmSubsurfaceNum, wsmHighSpeedMult, wsmRestRegainPerTurn, wdvBaseDownRateIn, wdvModEncMult, wdvHeavyEncMult, whbBaseSurfRateIn, whbInertRiseFt, wmwFallSaveMinFt, wmwHoldCheckPeriod, wtwProfTurnsPerEndPt, wtwCumCheckStep and kin) and re-pinned on the fold side so the boundary identities compile and ride the mutant battery. The findings: the vertical rates equal each other (both 2 inches) and are half the horizontal base (20 vs 40 feet); the Table 24 dive column matches the dive prose (x2 moderate, x3 heavy and severe); the encumbrance paradox (the moderate speed denominator 2 equals the moderate dive multiplier 2 - opposite meanings); the forty-foot agreement (the dive falling-damage threshold equals the waterfall save threshold); the mercy drift cap equals the light-current range; and the breath Con Checks step +2 while the treading Str Checks step +1.
banner.sentinel: THE SETTLE: census 424 -> 425; the gap report stays 186 closed / 0 open (closed - no flips this round); the swimmer's chain has no gaps.
banner.title: The WSG SWIMMER'S MOTION-CHAIN FOLD, R500: the second seam round after gap closure. The swimming rates (rules/wsgswim.h), the dive leg (rules/wsgdive.h), the surfacing and breath rules (rules/wsgbreath.h), the moving-water hazards (rules/wsgmwater.h) and the treading economy (rules/wsgtread.h) reconciled as one system: one swimmer, one chain, every rate and threshold cross-checked between its headers.
